te: In Moscow, the car exploded, the driver was thrown onto the road
de: In Moscow, a Toyota car exploded on the road, the driver was thrown onto the roadway by an explosive wave. This was reported on November 13 by Telegram-channel "112". The explosion occurred on Kirovogradskaya street in the south of Moscow. The car was badly damaged by the explosion…

d: Тело женщины в чемодане нашли на экотропе вдоль Юкковского ручья в поселке Парголово под Санкт-Петербургом. По подозрению в убийстве задержан ее 15-летний сын, сообщили 13 ноября в Следственном комитете по городу. Новость дополняется
te: The body of a woman in a suitcase was found in St. Petersburg, her 15-year-old son is suspected of murder
de: The body of a woman in a suitcase was found on an ecotrope along the Yukkovsky creek in the village of Pargolovo near St. Petersburg. Her 15-year-old son was arrested on suspicion of murder, the Investigative Committee for the city reported on November 13. The news is supplemented.
